 NEWS RELEASE 
 FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE 
 Medtronic reports second quarter fiscal 2027 results; performance reflects consistent execution across the portfolio 
 Strong performance in the company’s core franchises, scaling growth platforms and recent portfolio actions, strengthens the foundation for sustained long-term growth 
 GALWAY, Ireland – November 24, 2026 – Medtronic plc (NYSE: MDT), a global leader in healthcare technology, today announced financial results for its second quarter (Q2) of fiscal year 2027 (FY27), which ended October 30, 2026. 
 Key Highlights 
 • Revenue of $9.4 billion, increased 4.5% as reported and 6.5% organic, roughly 50 basis points above guidance midpoint 
 • GAAP diluted EPS of $2.20; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.34, ahead of guidance midpoint by 1 cent 
 • Completed the separation of the Diabetes Business (MiniMed Group, Inc.) via an exchange offer on October 15, 2026, the largest split-off in MedTech history 
 1 
 • Reiterated FY27 organic revenue growth guidance of 7.25% to 7.75% and diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance of $5.94 to $6.00, despite MiniMed separation 
 • Completed enrollment of the Sphere-360™ U.S. pivotal trial 
 • Announced intent to acquire Contego Medical, a privately held medical device company focused on innovative solutions for carotid artery disease and peripheral thrombectomy in November 
 • Received Category I CPT® Code approvals for Altaviva™ and Symplicity Spyral™ Systems, effective January 2028 
 • Announced FDA clearances for LigaSure™ RAS and Hugo™ RAS system for use in multiple general surgical procedures 
 “We delivered a strong second-quarter, with broad-based performance that reflects the strength of our business and our continued execution on our commitments,” said Geoff Martha, chairman and chief executive officer. “Our execution gives us confidence in our ability to sustain this momentum and deliver durable long-term performance. Our leading franchises are performing well, newer growth drivers are scaling, and we continue to invest organically and through disciplined M&A to add new technologies and expand our growth opportunities.” 
 Financial Results 
 Medtronic reported Q2 worldwide revenue of $9.364 billion, an increase of 4.5% as reported and 6.5% on an organic basis. The Q2 FY27 organic revenue growth comparison excludes: 
 • Other revenue, inclusive of Diabetes revenue, of $629 million in the current year versus $792 million in the prior year 
 • Scientia revenue of $26 million and SPR Therapeutics revenue of $28 million in the current year 
 • Revenue from the Dutch Obesity Clinic (NOK) divestiture with no revenue in the current year and $5 million in the prior year 
 • Foreign currency impact of -$16 million on the remaining net sales 
 2 
 Q2 revenue included: 
 • Cardiovascular Portfolio revenue of $3.785 billion increased 10.2% as reported and 10.4% organic, with high-teens increase in Electrophysiology Therapies, flat results in Interventional Cardiology Therapies, low-single digit increase in CardioVascular Surgery, and mid-single digit increase in Peripheral Vascular Health, all on an organic basis; Cardiac Ablation Solutions delivered 58% growth including 80% U.S. growth and 7 points of share gain 
 • Neuroscience Portfolio revenue of $2.705 billion increased 5.1% reported and 3.2% organic, with mid-single digit increase in Cranial & Spinal Technologies, low-single digit increase in Specialty Therapies, and low-single digit decrease in Neuromodulation, all on an organic basis 
 • Medical Surgical Portfolio revenue of $2.245 billion increased 3.9% as reported and 4.4% organic, with low-single digit increase in Surgical & Endoscopy, and high-single digit increase in Acute Care & Monitoring, all on an organic basis 
 Q2 GAAP operating profit and operating margin were $3.333 billion and 35.6%, respectively, an increase of 97.7% and 1,680 basis points, respectively. As detailed in the financial schedules included at the end of the release, Q2 non-GAAP operating profit and operating margin were $2.193 billion and 23.4%, respectively, an increase of 1.4% and a decrease of 70 basis points, respectively. 
 Q2 GAAP net income and diluted earnings per share (EPS) were $2.802 billion and $2.20, respectively, representing increases of 103.9% and 106.6%, respectively. As detailed in the financial schedules included at the end of this release, Q2 non-GAAP net income and non-GAAP diluted EPS were $1.700 billion and $1.34 respectively, representing decreases of 2.7% and 1.4%, respectively. 
 The Q2 GAAP numbers were impacted by the $2.0 billion gain recognized on the MiniMed separation. 
 3 
 Guidance 
 The company today reiterated its FY27 organic revenue growth and EPS guidance. The company continues to expect FY27 organic revenue growth guidance of 7.25% to 7.75% and diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance of $5.94 to $6.00. The company is maintaining these ranges while absorbing the impact of the Diabetes business separation. This EPS guidance includes an estimated neutral impact from foreign currency exchange based on recent rates. 
 “Our priority is to continue converting the momentum in our businesses into strong financial performance,” said Thierry Piéton, chief financial officer. “We are investing behind our highest-priority growth opportunities while maintaining a disciplined focus on productivity and efficiency. That approach supports our objectives for sustainable growth, margin expansion and long-term shareholder value.” 
 Video Webcast Information 
 Medtronic will host a video webcast today, November 24, at 7:30 a.m. EST (6:30 a.m. CST) to provide information about its business for the public, investors, analysts, and news media. This webcast can be accessed by clicking on the Quarterly Earnings icon at investorrelations.medtronic.com, and this earnings release will be archived at news.medtronic.com. Within 24 hours of the webcast, a replay of the webcast and transcript of the company’s prepared remarks will be available by clicking on the Past Events and Presentations link under the News & Events drop-down at investorrelations.medtronic.com. 
 Financial Schedules 
 The second quarter financial schedules and non-GAAP reconciliations can be viewed by clicking on the Quarterly Earnings link at investorrelations.medtronic.com. 
 About Medtronic 
 Bold thinking. Bolder actions. We are Medtronic. Medtronic plc, headquartered in Galway, Ireland, is the leading global healthcare technology company that boldly 
 4 
 attacks the most challenging health problems facing humanity by searching out and finding solutions. Our Mission — to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life — unites a global team of 90,000+ passionate people across more than 150 countries. Our technologies and therapies treat 70 health conditions and include cardiac devices, surgical robotics, surgical tools, patient monitoring systems, and more. Powered by our diverse knowledge, insatiable curiosity, and desire to help all those who need it, we deliver innovative technologies that transform the lives of two people every second, every hour, every day. Expect more from us as we empower insight-driven care, experiences that put people first, and better outcomes for our world. In everything we do, we are engineering the extraordinary. For more information on Medtronic (NYSE: MDT), visit www.Medtronic.com and follow on LinkedIn.

 NON-GAAP FINANCIAL MEASURES 
 This press release contains guidance and financial measures, including adjusted net income, adjusted diluted EPS, and organic revenue, which are considered “non-GAAP” financial measures under applicable SEC rules and regulations. Certain information in this press release also includes calculations or figures that have been prepared internally and have not been reviewed or audited by our independent registered public accounting firm. Use of different methods for preparing, calculating or presenting information may lead to differences and such differences may be material. 
 Medtronic management believes that non-GAAP financial measures provide information useful to investors in understanding the company’s underlying operational performance and trends and to facilitate comparisons with the performance of other companies in the med tech industry. Non-GAAP net income and diluted EPS exclude the effect of certain charges or gains that contribute to or reduce earnings but that result from transactions or events that management believes may or may not recur with similar materiality or impact to operations in future periods (Non-GAAP Adjustments). Medtronic generally uses non-GAAP financial measures to facilitate management’s review of the operational performance of the company and as a basis for strategic planning. Non-GAAP financial measures should be considered supplemental to and not a substitute for financial information prepared in accordance with U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), and investors are cautioned that Medtronic may calculate non-GAAP financial measures in a way that is different from other companies. Management strongly encourages investors to review the company’s consolidated financial statements and publicly filed reports in their entirety. Reconciliations of the non-GAAP financial measures to the most directly comparable GAAP financial measures are included in the financial schedules accompanying this press release. 
 6 
 Medtronic calculates forward-looking non-GAAP financial measures based on internal forecasts that omit certain amounts that would be included in GAAP financial measures. For instance, forward-looking organic revenue growth guidance excludes the impact of foreign currency fluctuations, revenue in the current and prior year reported as "Other”, as well as significant acquisitions, divestitures, or other significant discrete items. Forward-looking diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance also excludes other potential charges or gains that would be recorded as Non-GAAP Adjustments to earnings during the fiscal year. Medtronic does not attempt to provide reconciliations of forward-looking non-GAAP EPS guidance to projected GAAP EPS guidance because the combined impact and timing of recognition of these potential charges or gains is inherently uncertain and difficult to predict and is unavailable without unreasonable efforts. In addition, the company believes such reconciliations would imply a degree of precision and certainty that could be confusing to investors. Such items could have a substantial impact on GAAP measures of financial performance. 
 FINANCIAL COMPARISONS 
 References to quarterly or annual figures increasing, decreasing, or remaining flat are in comparison to fiscal year 2026, and references to sequential changes are in comparison to the prior fiscal quarter. Unless stated otherwise, quarterly and annual rates and ranges are given on an organic basis. References to organic revenue growth exclude the impact of foreign currency, second quarter revenue in the current and prior year reported as "Other”, as well as significant acquisitions, divestitures, or other significant discrete items. 
 BASIS OF DIABETES BUSINESS 
 Any reference to the financial measures of Medtronic Diabetes or its Diabetes Business refers to the financial measures for the period ending October 15, 2026, which coincides with Medtronic’s full divestment of its ownership interests in its Diabetes Business.
